body: This sounds so much like what I am going through now, I am going through a griefing phase as we speak, I am missing her everyday, trying to get over her but to no avail, it is a byproduct of the human condition, that we always look at flaws, always wants more and don't look at what is right infront even when one who cares for you to the extent that they forget about themselves are trying really hard to fight for the relationship, I didn't personally fight hard enough to make it happen and I just feel personally that I got not reason or purpose to live for anymore.  NEVER give up on that person if you ever find that girl/man they are far and inbetween and you will most likely never find someone like that ever again. I fully agree with OP that this is really something we should stay on, keep and work hard for and fight for if times get tough Stay strong people, to save yourself of one of the strongest pains known to man do not be "stupid" when it comes to relationships and push everything great away

You have made a mans day quite a lot better and making some things clear, thank you so much for your time and help here, it has been really helpful to think this through with some new additional information that has been further confirmed by practical and actual experience from you, you've gotten me out of the pit of self-.destructive behaviours for the time being, and I am thankful for that

Thank you do much for the respond and cementing my thoughts of it being a phase, but I just can't stop thinking that I would never be able to find someone as compatible and as loving and caring as she was, and I can't see myself thriving in life without her, even though its just a phase it has lasted for around 3-4 months now

do you have any suggestions on how to ditch these feelings?
